Boil water advisory lifted in Grand Meadow

By KTTC Staff
Published: Sep. 23, 2026 at 4:48 PM EDT|Updated: 13 hours ago
Add Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

GRAND MEADOW, Minn. (KTTC) – The city of Grand Meadow confirmed Wednesday afternoon its drinking water is safe again.

Grand Meadow issued a boil water advisory on Sept. 21 after a loss of pressure. Officials say the problem was system wide due to a well pump failure.

The Minnesota Department of Health also confirmed the water is safe to drink.
